description: Edit an SeoBrief before approval. The inner route does NOT accept free-text 'instructions' — refinement is structured. Pass `briefData` (the full replacement JSON for the brief outline — H2s, FAQs, keyword targets, etc.) and/or `status` ('approved' | 'rejected'). Approving via this tool fires L4 article/comparison generation immediately and returns { brief, operationId } — prefer seo_approve_briefs for the canonical approval step. Typical refinement loop: seo_get_brief → mutate briefData locally → seo_edit_brief with the new briefData (status omitted) → seo_approve_briefs. To change which brand truths the page is written from, pass `truthIds: { add?: string[], remove?: string[] }` ON ITS OWN (not with briefData or status). Added ids must be existing, non-deleted truths of this brand (brand_truth_list); they are stored with reason "Added manually". Returns { brief, truths, truthConflicts }.

attachedAssetId.description: When approving, attach an existing asset to the article.

briefData.description: Full structured replacement for the brief outline (object). Pulled from seo_get_brief, edited, sent back.

generateHeroImage.description: When approving, also generate a hero image (extra credits). Article-type briefs only — comparison/landing-type briefs return a 400 if this is set.

parentSource.description: Landing-brief approval: which parent LP draft to extend from.

status.description: Flip to 'approved' (fires generation) or 'rejected'. Omit to update briefData without changing status.

truthIds.description: Add/remove brand truths the page will be written from. Send alone — not with briefData or status.

add.description: Brand truth ids to add to the brief

remove.description: Brand truth ids to remove from the brief

verify.description: When approving an article-type brief, override the brand's default automatic verification pass (brand.brandSettings.seoVerification.enabled). When on (the brand default unless disabled), the written article runs through an automated fact/quality check and — if it fails — one repair attempt before finalizing; a brief that still fails after repair is flagged needs_human_review instead of drafted. No extra credits — it costs additional generation time (one or two extra LLM passes), not credit balance. Pass false to skip the check and always finalize as first written.

voiceProfileId.description: When approving, write in this voice profile.

name: seo_edit_brief
